PASS THE QUARTILES PARTITION THE 800 IDS BY THE AUTOPILOT'S SCORE: the four quartiles hold 200 ids each, every id once, in increasing id order within a quartile, and the largest difficulty of a quartile is at most the smallest of the next (ties by the smaller id first): true

PASS THE 800-ID PICKS ARE H48'S OWN: each group's pick on all 800 ids equals the 800-id pick H48's library reads from the same runs: true
